profile.headline: Senior Embedded Software Engineer | ELDP at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Software engineer and product-minded leader with 4+ years driving cross-functional delivery, improving team execution, and translating technical requirements into practical outcomes. Currently in Lockheed Martin's competitive Engineering Leadership Development Program (ELDP), rotating through roles including Agile leadership for a 9-person team, building software infrastructure from the ground up for an early-stage program, and serving as Control Account Manager for $1M+ in program budget.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led adoption of a standardized Scrum framework for the software team, introducing formal ceremonies, story-point estimation, and a shared Definition of Done. The approach was adopted well enough that the Chief Engineer invited systems, electrical, and mechanical engineering to observe and adapt it for their own teams.

Developed application-level flight software and built foundational software infrastructure for an early-stage program, including CI/CD pipelines, initial software builds, simulation integration, and approval and transfer workflows supporting 12 team members. Selected as the sole software engineer to represent the program at the first successful software integration event.

positions.title: GNC Modeling & Simulation Engineer
positions.description:
Served as core contributor migrating the team's simulation framework, and became the go-to resource during a period of turnover, training two new engineers and a new team lead on the simulation framework, dev container setup and day-to-day workflows.
  
Diagnosed and resolved a deeply hidden defect that was silently blocking the entire team's unit tests from running in the pipeline – a fix that took weeks to isolate, unblocked test coverage for the team, and was recognized by the Program Manager.
  
Served as Control Account Manager for two programs with over $1M in program budget, owning budget planning, cost performance tracking, and variance analysis.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Independently designed, built, and iterated on a customer-facing web application from an undefined brief, translating executive feedback into a polished product delivered on schedule, with no formal design specifications to work from.

positions.title: Program Performance Analyst CWEP
positions.description:
Career Work Experience Program (CWEP) at Lockheed Martin through the University of Central Florida.

Analyzed and reported weekly and monthly program performance metrics to enterprise leadership, enabling data-driven decision-making across 30+ programs.

Became the sole owner of program review coordination across 5 lines of business for Program Performance Directors – a function previously split across 5 people – with zero gaps in coverage or planning; recognized as the top facilitator among peers by a Program Performance Director.
  
Led On-Time Delivery across customer and internal contract teams, coordinating 30+ people, improving delivery performance and consistently keeping late shipments <5% of the total shipments month-over-month.

projects.title: Sherlock
projects.description: Sherlock is a project that uses machine learning techniques to determine user responses to media stimuli and quantify their reactions for research and game development purposes.

projects.title: C Compiler
projects.description: Created a compiler that translates code from the C programming language into machine code.
